title: About KPGU | Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University
content: p Gujarat Cell of Industry Commissionerate, Govt. of Gujarat, (2021 onwards).   Registered Section 8 Company named "Krishna Edu Foundation" - KEF under company Act 2013 and provided end to end support to innovators and startups through Seed Funding, Co-Working Spaces, Mentoring, and Networking.   Selected as Implementing Agency (Group 2) under MeitY Startup Hub-GENESIS scheme in 2024.   10000+ Students Outreached and Sensitized for innovation in 2020-2024.
